title: The Median Earner Made $169
caption:
The median indie product that actually makes money makes $169 a month.

A researcher pulled all 10,150 products off TrustMRR on Sept 4 — Stripe-verified revenue, not screenshots. Half took no money at all in 30 days. 102 products took 76% of everything on the platform.

The caveat I keep repeating to myself: it's a self-selected list, nobody connects Stripe to display a zero. But developer tools came in at 2.1% above $5k MRR, and that's the category I keep building in.

What's your 30-day number?
